content.text: Let me check what the date format looks like and understand the data better:

input.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT FLX_ANN_MOI, SOI_ANN, SOI_MOI 
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS 
ORDER BY FLX_ANN_MOI DESC 
LIMIT 10

content.text: I can see FLX_ANN_MOI = 202503 represents March 2025. Now let me check the region codes and understand which field represents the prescribing professional's region:

input.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT EXE_INS_REG, PRE_INS_REG 
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS 
WHERE FLX_ANN_MOI = 202503
LIMIT 10

content.text: Let me check the dimension table to see what region 0 or unknown values might look like:

input.sql:
SELECT BEN_RES_REG, BEN_RES_REG_LIB 
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_REGION 
ORDER BY BEN_RES_REG

content.content: {"columns": ["BEN_RES_REG", "BEN_RES_REG_LIB"], "rows": [[5, "Régions et Départements d'outre-mer"], [11, "Ile-de-France"], [24, "Centre-Val de Loire"], [27, "Bourgogne-Franche-Comté"], [28, "Normandie"], [32, "Hauts-de-France - Nord-Pas-de-Calais-Picardie"], [44, "Grand Est"], [52, "Pays de la Loire"], [53, "Bretagne"], [75, "Aquitaine-Limousin-Poitou-Charentes"], [76, "Languedoc-Roussillon-Midi-Pyrénées"], [84, "Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes"], [93, "Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur et Corse"], [99, "Inconnu"]], "truncated": false}

content.text: Perfect! Now I understand the data. Region 99 is "Inconnu" (Unknown), which we should exclude. The PRE_INS_REG appears to be the prescribing professional's region. Now let me query for the statutory share reimbursed by Health Insurance (PRS_REM_MNT) aggregated by the prescribing professional's region for March 2025:

input.sql:
SELECT 
  dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB as region_name,
  SUM(fr.PRS_REM_MNT) as statutory_share_reimbursed
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS fr
LEFT JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_REGION dr ON fr.PRE_INS_REG = dr.BEN_RES_REG
WHERE fr.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202503
  AND fr.PRE_INS_REG != 99  -- Exclude unknown region
GROUP BY dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB
ORDER BY statutory_share_reimbursed DESC
LIMIT 3

content.text: Perfect! I have found the three regions with the highest statutory share reimbursed by Health Insurance in claims processed in March 2025, excluding the unknown region.

SELECT 
  dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB as region,
  SUM(fr.PRS_REM_MNT) as statutory_share_reimbursed
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS fr
LEFT JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_REGION dr ON fr.PRE_INS_REG = dr.BEN_RES_REG
WHERE fr.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202503
  AND fr.PRE_INS_REG != 99
GROUP BY dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB
ORDER BY statutory_share_reimbursed DESC
LIMIT 3
